Name: Some other nude chararcters mod
Author: SummerChu
Description:
This is a mod that I made for other nude portrait mods I found:

Here are a few:

Buxom Cleavage Portraits Fully Nude by AirplaneRandy: Found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35/?]HERE[/url]
Maru and Maru Hospital nude Mod by vork88: Found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/240/?]HERE[/url]
Anime style nude portraits by Nop: Found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/247/?]HERE[/url]

There were some things that REALLY annoyed me, such as:

The bowlegs of the characters
No glasses for Maru
The bow is not consistent with Abigail

So, they've been fixed.

Rather than use some other person's mod, I liked the vanilla sprites better, so, here they are.

If you want to know how to install it, it's simple.
1. Download xnb files
2. Navigate to GameFolder\Content\Characters
3. Paste new files into folder
*NOTE* Make sure you back them up in some way, shape, or form, as they will be replaced.
